Network Rail's real ATS lives at careers.networkrail.co.uk (Tribepad-style URLs, e.g. /jobs/job/{slug}/{id}), but that host is CURRENTLY UNREACHABLE — WebFetch explicitly reported 'certificate has expired' on both the root and a job-detail URL; careershub.networkrail.co.uk fails identically. This looks like a genuinely expired/broken TLS cert on Network Rail's careers subdomain (not just the local intercepting proxy), since the parent www.networkrail.co.uk loads fine. Recommend the jobs2web SuccessFactors feed as the integration point.

name: Civil Service Fast Stream
notes: Verified by background research agent. faststream.gov.uk 301-redirects to www.civil-service-careers.gov.uk/fast-stream/. Structurally Fast Stream is NOT a per-vacancy job board like the other employers — it's a single annual application campaign (18 schemes) with fixed opening/closing windows, applied to as one bundled application rather than discrete requisitions, so there is no 'jobs list' endpoint to poll. Its pages link to civilservicejobs.service.gov.uk for account/support, but that domain returned a bot-detection interstitial ('Quick Check Needed') on a plain curl request — actively gated against non-browser clients. Recommend treating Fast Stream as a calendar/announcement watch (scheme opening dates on civil-service-careers.gov.uk) rather than a daily jobs-API poll target.
